summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of WALKFOLIO 3D interactive portfolio. All core features tested and verified working correctly including intro/loading flow, 3D world with player movement, menu system with all panels (About, Projects, Experience, Skills, Contact, Settings), 2D portfolio fallback, and resume PDF access.

warnings.issue: Deprecation warnings for THREE.Clock and PCFSoftShadowMap
warnings.impact: Console warnings only, no functional impact
warnings.recommendation: Update to THREE.Timer and PCFShadowMap in future refactor

warnings.issue: GPU stall warnings in headless browser due to ReadPixels
warnings.impact: Expected behavior in software rendering, no impact on production
warnings.recommendation: No action needed - this is normal for headless WebGL testing
